source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U08: Apply fitness,merchantable-quality and examination exceptions to caveat emptor

payload.title: Buyer beware is not a universal seller defence
payload.core_explanation_md:
A buyer choosing goods solely by their own judgment presents a different case from a buyer communicating a purpose and relying on a seller skill in the relevant supply business. The source identifies a fitness condition for the described reliance situation. Sale by description and merchantable quality have their own requirements.

Examination can affect defects that the examination ought to reveal;it does not automatically excuse every hidden defect. Trade usage and compatible express terms also matter. Record the stated purpose,reliance,seller business,inspection scope and defect before invoking caveat emptor as if the phrase alone decided the dispute.

self_check.prompt_text: Does any inspection automatically remove every implied protection?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The relevant discoverability and other conditions must be examined.

payload.stem_md: The buyer disclosed a specific purpose and relied on the supplier skill,but the defence invokes buyer beware without analysing those facts. What is missing?

options.text_md: The applicable purpose,reliance and supply-business exception
options.explanation_md: The doctrine has conditions and exceptions.

options.text_md: A rule that every buyer choice is fully guaranteed

payload.correct_explanation_md: The doctrine has conditions and exceptions.

payload.stem_md: A superficial inspection occurred,but a stipulated hidden defect was not reasonably discoverable from it. What must the review distinguish?

options.text_md: Any inspection proves every defect was known
No examination can ever affect any implied term
options.explanation_md: The source identifies a qualified examination rule.

options.text_md: Discoverable defects from those not revealed by the relevant reasonable examination
options.explanation_md: The scope and facts of the exception matter.

options.text_md: The seller may privately label every defect visible

payload.correct_explanation_md: The scope and facts of the exception matter.
